description: This file defines a SwiftUI view component named OpenClawChatComposer, which provides a user interface for composing chat messages, including text input, attachment handling, model and session selection, and connection status display. It includes platform-specific implementations for macOS and iOS. The file also contains utility code for handling image pasting and file attachments in the macOS environment using AppKit, and a text view wrapper for text input on macOS.

classes.name: ChatComposerNSTextView
classes.description: Custom NSTextView subclass for handling message input, supporting paste and send behaviors, used in macOS for text composition.

classes.name: ChatComposerPasteSupport
classes.description: Utility enum providing support for pasting images and files from the clipboard, with functions to extract image attachments and file references.

methods.name: makeCoordinator
methods.description: Creates a coordinator object to act as the delegate for the NSTextView, handling text changes and other delegate callbacks.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates and configures the NSScrollView containing the custom NSPasteboard-enabled NSTextView.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the NSScrollView's document view with the latest text content and manages focus.

methods.name: pickFilesMac
methods.description: Opens an NSOpenPanel for selecting image files on macOS and adds selected URLs as attachments.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles drag-and-drop file URL drops on macOS, adding the dropped files as attachments.

methods.name: loadPhotosPickerItems
methods.description: Loads image data from PhotosPickerItems asynchronously and adds them as attachments.
